items.title: Run iOS on Android hardware
items.oneliner: Open-source XNU boot stack runs iOS 16.5 on Android phones and QEMU with working home screen, settings, and apps.

items.title: Triangulate map polygons much faster
items.oneliner: ISC-licensed C++ and WebAssembly triangulator processes 3.7 million polygons in 489 ms and beats earcut in browsers.

items.title: Fix mouse input in NT 3.x
items.oneliner: MIT-licensed driver adds seamless QEMU and VMware mouse integration for Windows NT 3.x with ISO-based install.

items.title: Learn ZFS internals interactively
items.oneliner: Interactive ZFS walkthrough maps animations to OpenZFS source lines so you can understand uberblocks, txgs, and recovery.

items.title: Jailbreak the Switch 2
items.oneliner: Software-only tethered Switch 2 jailbreak on firmware 23.0.1 enables homebrew, save management, and game modding today.

items.title: Try a terminal world model
items.oneliner: A 360M model predicts terminal screen state changes, letting you test vim, tmux, and shell workflows in-browser.

items.title: Study a simpler block device
items.oneliner: Hands-on engineering writeup explains a production block device over object storage, with concrete tradeoffs and implementation details.

items.title: Recreate NetHack cave generation
items.oneliner: Detailed dungeon generation walkthrough shows the exact cellular automata passes behind NetHack's Gnomish Mines caves.

items.title: Upgrade to Crystal 1.22
items.oneliner: Crystal 1.22 ships 251 changes, including Tier 1 aarch64 Linux support and lower-memory DWARF parsing improvements.

items.title: Stop using LLM confidence scores
items.oneliner: Practical critique explains why LLM-generated confidence scores fail without historical calibration data and proper probability modeling.
